messages.text:
Sorry to hear that. Faulty units go through RMA: fill in the intake form and you'll get a return label, then processing takes up to 10 days once it reaches the warehouse. Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

One thing first, was the unit ever overclocked or modified? That isn't covered.

Which miner is it, and what's it doing?

No never overlcooked  it's an jingleminer  it dose not mine on solo only on pool also when plug in to my laptop no response for updates an when I connect it to my wifi the ip address doesn't work Http://192.168.4.1 for monitoring

That IP only works while the miner is in its own setup hotspot. Once it joins your wifi, it drops that address and your router gives it a new one, so check the router's device list for the miner and use that IP.

Fastest hands-on help is our Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post there and mention @nullhashrate (JD).

Does it show as connected on your router, and is it actually hashing on pool right now?
On pool yes solo no it doesn't show the bitcoin price

Both point the same way: the miner can reach your pool but not the open internet, so the price ticker is blank and solo fails. Set DNS to 8.8.8.8 in the miner's network settings and reboot it. If solo still fails, check the solo stratum URL and that your own BTC address is the worker name.

What firmware version does it show? I'll get JD on it either way.

Easiest way: pull the power, wait about 10 seconds, plug it back in. That's a full reboot. If you can reach the miner's dashboard in your browser, there's also a restart option in the settings page.

Give it a minute or two after power-up before you check the price ticker again.

Did the DNS setting save before you reboot?
